text: The invoice tests are failing. Find where formatCents is defined, run npm test to see the failure, fix the bug in place with a shell command (no new files), and rerun npm test until it passes. Briefly say what was wrong.

{"command":"sed -i '' 's/\\${rest}/${String(rest).padStart(2, \"0\")}/' src/money.js && sed -n '2,6p' src/money.js && echo \"--- npm test ---\" && npm test 2>&1 | tail -20; echo \"exit: ${pipestatus[1]:-$?}\"","description":"Zero-pad cents in formatCents and rerun npm test"}

The invoice tests pass now.

**What was wrong:** `formatCents` in `src/money.js` built the output as `` `$${dollars}.${rest}` ``, so the cents part wasn't zero-padded. `1205` became `$12.5` instead of `$12.05`, which failed the assertion in `test.js`.

**Fix:** I changed the cents part to `String(rest).padStart(2, "0")` with `sed -i` on the existing file. No new files were created. `npm test` now prints `all invoice tests passed` and exits 0.
